page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a large-scale general-purpose server type based on x86_64 architecture and managed under the KVM hypervisor. The system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The hardware architecture maintains a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, delivering 512.0 GB of total system memory at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The server type does not feature discrete GPU accelerators and includes no bundled local storage, operating entirely with external network-attached storage volumes for system and data persistence.

Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput node-to-node communication. The reliance on remote storage introduces an I/O tradeoff, making storage throughput dependent on network link conditions and external block storage configurations. However, the dedicated CPU allocation eliminates shared-core scheduling contention, ensuring predictable multi-threaded performance. The substantial single-node capacity offers qualitative resource density efficiency, allowing organizations to run heavy concurrent workloads without orchestrating multiple smaller virtual machines.

Given its balance of 128 dedicated cores, 512 GB RAM, and high-bandwidth 64 Gbps networking, the ecs.g7.32xlarge is well structured for centralized enterprise workloads. Recommended deployment profiles include large-scale web application serving, memory-resident caching systems, distributed data processing nodes, large relational databases relying on networked storage, and massive continuous integration compilation clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processors and 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 allocation of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The instance incorporates a high-bandwidth 64 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no integrated local storage or hardware GPUs, necessitating network-attached storage solutions for persistent disk volumes. With dedicated processing cores and substantial memory capacity, it provides consistent computational density for enterprise-grade applications. The ecs.g7.32xlarge is appropriate for large distributed caching systems, relational database environments on networked block storage, heavy web serving tiers, and parallel build pipelines.
